hook: → 观点卡：UPS物流商业史与多公司生意模式变迁
lines: Guest Marc Levinson explains that the foundational innovation behind UPS was an organizational shift to a centralized sorting model that aggregated packages to maximize route density rather than relying on advanced technology.

The host and guest note that early logistics efficiency was achieved by applying rigid scientific management principles, standardizing every operational task from vehicle maintenance to driver movements.

The discussion highlights how UPS successfully navigated early scaling by securing long-term service contracts with retailers and later lobbying regulators to classify parcel delivery as a unique business distinct from general trucking.
The conversation points out that a strong internal promotion culture initially delayed UPS's adoption of digital technologies like barcoding due to a lack of external technical expertise.
title: Marc Levinson on How UPS Created Modern Logistics
